author: GameTrailers
description:
Get ready for the latest Wholesome Direct digital showcase on Saturday, June 6, 2026 starting at 9:00 AM Pacific, 12:00 PM Eastern. Returning for its seventh iteration, Wholesome Direct is back and ready to highlight the latest up-and-coming titles for players looking for uplifting, joyful, and hopeful games. The Wholesome Games team has carefully curated a selection of 50+ emotionally resonant titles with news including world premieres, demo announcements, and many more surprises from studios and publishers of all sizes. This year's Wholesome Direct will include news and surprises from amazing developers including Frontier, NPC Studio, Stray Fawn Studio, Spry Fox, and many more, delivered by returning host and Wholesome Games organizer Jenny Windom and a variety of guest co-hosts specializing in the wholesome and cozy niche including Gab Smolders, Knimbley, NintenTalk, and more. For more information, visit https://wholesomegames.com/

#IGN #Gaming #SummerOfGaming
title: Wholesome Direct 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Tune-in on June 4th, 2026 at 4PM PT for the latest Women-Led Games Showcase! 

"Women-Led Games is a yearly showcase platform built to put attention where it should already be: on the women-led and majority-women studios making some of the most interesting work in the industry.

We run two flagship showcases a year, Summer alongside Summer Game Fest, Winter with The Game Awards, plus interviews, partnerships, and a community of developers, press, and players who care about the same thing we do.

The talent is already there. The platform exists to make sure you see it." 

#IGN #Gaming #SummerOfGaming
title: Women-Led Games: Summer Game Fest Edition 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this new gameplay trailer for Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Service, a brand new cozy game from Destroyer Doggo. Take your Panda around a particularly dirty town, cleaning at your own pace as you make everything just that little bit cleaner. The soothing gameplay was designed to be the perfect pairing with some relaxing music or an audiobook. Bring up to 4 friends along and clean together! 
Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services is coming soon for PC (Steam), Xbox One, and Xbox Series X|S
title: Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Combat First Look Trailer for God of War Laufey, the next adventure in the third-person action-adventure God of War series developed by Sony Santa Monica. Players will get the rundown on the new additions to Laufey's core combat, with Santa Monica Studio’s combat designers detailing the new mechanics that serve Laufey's lethal agility, powerful abilities, and legendary sword weapon. God of War Laufey is coming soon to PlayStation 5 (PS5).

#GodOfWarLaufey #Gaming #IGN
title: God of War Laufey - Official Combat First Look Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Discover how to wield the black mist of Senna in 2XKO! Effortlessly switch between zoning and rushdown with Senna's unique forms and learn how to convert a stray hit into big damage! 
Fight as Senna in 2XKO on June 9th, 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: 2XKO - Official Senna Gameplay Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a fresh look at The Dark West, an upcoming occult-tinged action-RPG set in the Old West, ahead of the playable demo that will be released on Steam on June 10. Wishlist it if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3574750/The_Dark_West/
title: The Dark West: Official Demo Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The Lost Wild is a survival horror game where you don't fight dinosaurs, but you are forced to survive around them.

The Lost Wild is build on "three things: observation, instinct, and restraint." There is a big focus on these dinosaurs acting like real creatures, with their own instincts, behaviors, and drives. 

The Lost Wild will be released on PlayStation 5 in 2027.

#ign  #Gaming #PS5
title: The Lost Wild - Official Gameplay Trailer | State of Play 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this reveal trailer for RuneCipher, an all new active-combat Strategy RPG from Rasmalai Studios. Take charge of the battle by parrying incoming attacks to open enemies up for a counter, but don't over-do it, your stamina dicates your action and leaving yourself low is leaving yourself open! 
Experience a rich story, told through a hand crafted sprite graphics and tense strategic combat! RuneCipher is coming soon to PC (Steam)
title: RuneCipher - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer for LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, the hit action-adventure open-world game developed by TT Games. Players will witness the story of Bruce Wayne and Batman himself, paying homage to the Gotham City hero across Batman films, television, comic books, and games. Take the adventure on the go with LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight launching on September 18 for Nintendo Switch 2, with the game being available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
title: LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight - Official Nintendo Switch 2 Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out this trailer for Goddess of Strategy, a brand new roguelike strategy RPG from Lost Grace Games. Lead your mortal warriors across the grid of battle in an epic quest to restore the power of the Olympians. 
Godess of Strategy is coming soon to PC (Steam)
title: Goddess of Strategy - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss the announcement trailer for Hungry Hangry Doodles, an all new cozy game from Maple Taco. Unlock new doodles, or draw your own, to eat snacks and grow in size, reaching new foods! Complete levels to unlock stars and discover all new foods. 
Hungry Hangry Doodles is coming soon to PC (Steam)
title: Hungry Hangry Doodles - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the 0.7 Update Launch Trailer for Assetto Corsa EVO, the hit racing simulation game developed by Kunos Simulazioni. Players can check out the latest update, packed with 4 new cars, a new particle system, and major improvements to physics, rendering, and more. Update 0.7 for Assetto Corsa EVO is available now for PC (Steam).
title: Assetto Corsa EVO - Official 0.7 Update Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the 'Alwayz Ready!' Season 3 Trailer for WWE 2K26, the latest action wrestling simulation game developed by Visual Concepts. Players can get a look at new content with the latest update, featuring Matt Cardona, Torrie Wilson, Brian Pillman, and La Parka. Season 3 for WWE 2K26 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam).
title: WWE 2K26 - Official 'Alwayz Ready!' Season 3 Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Juno Beach Update 20 Map Overview Trailer for Hell Let Loose, the hit World War 2 first-person shooter developed by Expression Games. Players will get an extended look at the new map as they fight on Juno Beach, a map that recaptures the Normandy coastline during the opening stages of the Allied invasion of occupied France. Juno Beach is launching with Update 20 for Hell Let Loose, available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Hell Let Loose - Official Juno Beach Update 20 Map Overview Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Here's a fresh look at Sorry, My King in this latest trailer for the upcoming 1-bit pixel roguelite game where every step costs time and every coin feeds the system. Explore procedural maps, fight card battles, and gather 5000 gold in 7 days to pay your debt to the king. Or discover why the debt exists at all. The new Sorry, My King trailer showcases gameplay, including combat, enemies, and more. Sorry, My King will be available on PC. You can join wishlist it on Steam and sign up for the playtest if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4539630/Sorry_My_King/
title: Sorry, My King - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Get a deep dive into what you can expect with Update 1.3 for Jurassic World Evolution 3 in this latest trailer for the dinosaur park simulation game. Update 1.3 brings new improvements and updates, including perch point scenery pieces, changes to aviaries, the new hatchery drone, the return of the Ceradactylus, and more. Jurassic World Evolution 3 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). The free Update 1.3 for Jurassic World Evolution 3 will be available on June 16, 2026.
title: Jurassic World Evolution 3 - Official Update 1.3 Highlights Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Don't miss the Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Launch Trailer for Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth, the latest entry in the third-person action-adventure RPG series developed by Square Enix. Players will join Cloud and company on a thrilling adventure across iconic locations in Gaia to thwart the plans of Sephiroth and save the planet once and for all. Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth is available now for Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Series X|S, alongside being available on PlayStation 5 (PS5) and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Final Fantasy 7 Rebirth - Official Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Launch Trailer
